edits.old: Then the grant refuses the statement, the boundary test fails the build and nothing is released
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses the statement, the boundary test fails the build and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC4 The business rules of this step hold (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the closure step is triggered by the award confirmation of the lot
    When the step evaluates R-UNI-47 and writes its result
    Then the decision record is written before the closure answer, no table of rwb-case is written, no cross-schema join leaves rwb_debtsale, and no person name, identity number or unmasked account identifier is stored

  Scenario: AC5 A consumed activity that times out is retried and writes nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case contract does not answer inside 2 s
    When the closure activity runs
    Then the step waits and retries on the workflow's own schedule, nothing is written and no closure is answered

  Scenario: AC6 A consumed call that fails or does not answer changes nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the breaker of a consumed contract is open
    When the closure element is read
    Then the read answers 503 with the platform error envelope and nothing changes

  Scenario: AC7 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the case is in the state `CASE_CLOSED_SOLD` after its closure
    When the award signal of the lot arrives for the same account
    Then no rule fires, nothing changes, no record is written and the repeat is counted
